description:
The BULLS Copperhead AM Carbon is a premium all‑mountain eMTB built for riders who demand top-tier performance, lightweight carbon handling, and the latest Bosch Smart System technology. With a carbon front triangle, 150mm of plush suspension, and a 12‑speed Shimano drivetrain, this bike is engineered to crush technical climbs, rip descents, and stay composed when the trail gets wild.

Motor and Battery

Motor: Bosch Performance Line CX (BDU38), the newest generation with powerful, responsive support for steep climbs and aggressive riding.

Battery: Bosch PowerTube 600Wh (Smart System), fully integrated into the downtube for a sleek look and balanced weight distribution - 48 lbs (without battery) / 53 lbs (with battery).

Display: Bosch System Controller (Top Tube integrated) + Mini Remote — clean, modern, and easy to use even on rough terrain.

Suspension and Frame

Fork: RockShox Lyrik Select Charger RC, 150mm travel, 29" Boost, DebonAir+ for buttery small‑bump sensitivity and big‑hit control.

Rear Shock: RockShox Deluxe Select+ 210×55mm, delivering 150mm of smooth, predictable rear travel.

Frame: Carbon front triangle + alloy rear triangle with internal cable routing, integrated front and rear lighting ports, and modern all‑mountain geometry. Sizes: 40 / 43 / 47 / 51 cm.

Drivetrain and Brakes

Drivetrain: Shimano Deore XT M8100 12‑speed with a wide‑range 10–51T cassette for steep climbs and fast descents.

Crankset: Lasco 36T narrow‑wide chainring, optimized for Bosch BDU38.

Brakes: Shimano BR‑M6220 4‑piston hydraulic disc brakes with 203mm rotors front and rear — massive stopping power for aggressive riding.

Wheels and Tires

Wheels: Ryde Disc 30, 29" Boost, 30mm inner width — strong, stable, and ready for technical terrain.

Tires: Schwalbe Magic Mary Trail 29×2.4" (front & rear), Soft compound — legendary grip for loose, rocky, and steep trails.

Additional Features

Handlebar & Stem: Integrated carbon cockpit (Rumble Flying Wing Pro 50), 780mm width, 20mm rise — lightweight and precise.

Dropper Post: Limotec Z1 dropper post with size‑specific travel (75–170mm).

Lighting: Integrated Comus front light (up to 30 lux) and rear stay‑mounted light — powered directly by the Bosch system.

Pedals & Saddle: Wellgo MTB pedals + Selle Royal SRX saddle for comfort and control.

Technology and Design

Integrated Lighting: Front and rear lights built into the frame — clean, protected, and always powered.

Carbon Performance: Lightweight front triangle for improved handling, stiffness, and responsiveness.

Class‑1 eBike: Pedal assist up to 20 mph — trail‑legal and ready for long backcountry rides.

Key Takeaway

The Copperhead AM Carbon is a high‑performance all‑mountain eMTB that blends carbon precision, Bosch Smart System power, and premium RockShox suspension. Whether you're charging steep climbs, flowing through technical singletrack, or pushing hard on big descents, this bike delivers the speed, control, and confidence serious riders expect.
